prompt: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for the constant oracle f(x) = 0 for every 3-bit input x, using a REVERSED qubit-ordering convention compared to the standard task: here the ANCILLA is qubit 0 (not the highest-index qubit), and the input register is qubits 1, 2, 3 (not 0, 1, 2). State explicitly: this is the opposite convention from the unperturbed dj_constant_4q task, where the ancilla is the highest-indexed qubit. Steps: initialize qubit 0 (ancilla) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 4 qubits, apply the oracle (for this constant-zero function, no gates at all — the oracle does nothing), then apply Hadamard to qubits 1, 2, 3 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 4-qubit state; no measurement.
